privacyPolicy.title: Personal data processing policy
privacyPolicy.subtitle: {unitName} · Policy version: {version}
privacyPolicy.notOfficial: This is not an official page of <church>The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints</church>. It is a unit tool, approved by its bishop or branch president, that follows the guidelines of the <handbook>General Handbook, 38.8.21.2</handbook>.
privacyPolicy.discrepancy: Faithful translation of the Spanish text. In case of any discrepancy, the Spanish version prevails until the data controller adapts the policy to their country.
privacyPolicy.missingController: This installation hasn't completed the data controller's details yet (name, address, phone and email), which the law requires to be published. Until then, you shouldn't provide data in this app.
privacyPolicy.missingControllerAdmin: Complete the data controller's details in Settings.
privacyPolicy.shortNotice: {controllerName} uses this data only to organize this activity and does not share it for other purposes. It keeps it for {retentionMonths} months from registration or until the activity ends, whichever is later. Full policy: <policy>data policy</policy>.

s1.title: 1. Data controller
s1.body: {name}. Address: {address}. Phone: {phone}. Email: {email}. City and country: {city}.

s2.title: 2. Purpose
s2.body: To organize the unit's activities each person signs up for: coordinating participants, slots, transportation, lodging, meals and, on temple trips, the ordinances each person wishes to perform; and to contact registrants with information about that activity.
s2.notices: Leaders with permission get a notice by email or Telegram when there are new registrations, with no names or data: the details can only be seen inside the app, while signed in. The app's emails and notices never contain confidential or sensitive information.

s3.title: 3. Legal basis
s3.body: The data subject's explicit consent (Ecuador's Organic Law on Personal Data Protection, art. 7 and art. 26). The ordinances chosen are sensitive data, because they relate to religious belief.

s4.title: 4. Data collected
s4.body: ID card or passport number, date of birth, name, phone, email, gender, services chosen (transportation, lodging, meals) and ordinances; plus the IP address and date of submission, as evidence of consent. Each activity asks only for the data it needs.

s5.title: 5. Retention
s5.body: {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} from registration or until the activity ends, whichever is later. After that, the data is permanently deleted.

s6.title: 6. Database
s6.body: The data is stored in a private database of this installation, hosted on Supabase.

s7.title: 7. Source of the data
s7.body: Provided by the data subject or, for minors, by their father, mother or guardian.

s8.title: 8. Further purposes
s8.body: None. The data is not used for any other activity or for personal, political or commercial purposes.

s10.title: 10. Transfers
s10.body: The app is hosted on Vercel and the database on Supabase, outside the country.
s10.google: The form is protected by Google's reCAPTCHA, which receives technical data from the browser.

s11.title: 11. If the data is not provided

s13.title: 13. Withdrawing consent
s13.body: It is free and done by email to the data controller: <mail>{email}</mail>.

s14.title: 14. Data subject's rights
s14.body: Access, rectification and updating, deletion, objection, annulment and restriction of processing, by email to the data controller: <mail>{email}</mail>.

s15.title: 15. Portability
s15.body: You can request a copy of your data by email to the data controller.

s16.title: 16. Where to complain
s16.body: To the data controller (item 1) or to Ecuador's Superintendency of Personal Data Protection.

s17.title: 17. Automated decisions
s17.body: None. No profiling of people is done.
